sections.label: What to do with the data

blocked.file: This import came from a file uploaded by hand, so it cannot be retried by itself. Upload the file again and choose only what failed.
blocked.versionGone: The version of the template this import used is no longer in the catalogue, so it was not retried: another version could load different data.
blocked.complete: Everything of this import went in: there is nothing to retry.
blocked.undone: This import was undone, so there is nothing to retry.

import.adminOnly: Only an administrator can see and import templates.
import.intro: Load a template: it fills your apps with its data — a menu, services, tables — ready to use.
import.chooseHint: Choose a template for your business, or upload a .blueprint.zip you exported or saved as a backup.
import.empty: There are no templates for your business yet.
import.loadError: The templates could not be loaded right now. You can still import a file.
import.readError: The file could not be read: {reason}
import.tooBig: the file is larger than 5 MB.

review.title: Review what it brings
review.name: Name
review.appsHint: Choose the apps to load. What is already in your business stays as it is.

review.appUnknown: This business does not have this app: nothing of it will load.
review.personal: Personal data: it loads only from a backup.
review.nothingLoads: Nothing of this file can load in your business: none of its apps is on.

report.title: Import report
report.unfinished: This is the report of your last import of {name} ({date}). Not everything went in.

export.adminOnly: Only an administrator can export the business.
export.intro: Packs this business's apps — and, if you want, their data — into a file you can load in another business or keep as a backup.
export.name: Name
export.nameRequired: Write a name for the file.
export.backupHint: A private copy to restore this business. It takes your customers too; never people, PINs or fiscal data.
export.templateHint: To give to another business. It never takes customers, people, PINs or fiscal data.
export.appsHint: Choose which apps the file registers and whether their data travels with it.
export.nothingToCopy: Nothing of its own to copy
export.loadError: The apps of this business could not be loaded.
export.noApps: This business has no app on to export.

reset.adminOnly: Only an administrator can undo imports or reset the business.
reset.undoHint: Removes only what that import brought. What you created afterwards stays.
reset.undoConfirmMessage: The row this import brought will be removed. What you created afterwards stays. | The {n} rows this import brought will be removed. What you created afterwards stays.
reset.notRemoved: {app} — {n} row could not be removed | {app} — {n} rows could not be removed
reset.title: Reset the business
reset.intro: Removes for good the data you mark. It cannot be undone: if in doubt, export a copy first.
reset.keeps: Only what each section lists here is removed. Sales, invoices, fiscal records, people and their access, files and the business's settings always stay.
reset.loading: Working out what each section has…
reset.loadError: What each section has could not be worked out.
reset.nothing: There is nothing to reset: no section has data.
reset.shared: Resetting the business is not available yet. Undo an import instead, or remove what you want from each app.
reset.confirmMessage: {n} row will be removed for good: | {n} rows will be removed for good:

blueprintCard.title: Start with a business like yours
blueprintCard.hint: Choose the one most like yours and we leave your apps ready with its catalogue in one go. Then put in your own details.
blueprintCard.loadError: The templates to start with could not be loaded.

blueprintCard.partialOther: Something else did not go in.

error.body: The figures and the logs are not available right now. You can try again.

resources.heading: Cloud resources
resources.notMeasured: CPU, memory and connections are not measured per business: ERPlora's servers serve every business at once and grow by themselves when needed.
resources.denied: Only the owner or an administrator can see how much the hub is using.

updates.heading: What we have updated
updates.auto: This hub updates itself when we publish a new version, without stopping the service: there is nothing to install.
updates.unknownDate: We do not know when this version was published.

failed.heading: Failed events
failed.hint: Fix the cause (a permission, an app that is off…) and resend. The event is never edited: if the cause is still there, it fails again and comes back here.
failed.notRetryable: This one cannot be resent: {app} is no longer on in this business. Turn it on and resend it.

empty.heading: All in order
empty.body: No failed events. The queue of events lives in the database: a restart never loses it.

failed.errorBody: The queue of failed events could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again.
failed.denied: Only the owner or an administrator can see the failed events.

retryAllConfirm.title: Resend every failed event?
retryAllConfirm.message: The ones that can be resent go back to the queue; those for an app that is off stay here.

discardConfirm.title: Discard this event for good?
discardConfirm.message: “{event}” will never reach {app} again. Who discarded it, when and why are kept.
discardConfirm.consequence: If it was a sale for Invoicing, that sale stays without its invoice.

reasons.gone: that event is no longer in the queue; refresh the list.
reasons.appOff: the app it was for is no longer on in this business; turn it on and resend it.
reasons.denied: only the owner or an administrator can do it.
reasons.unknown: the reason could not be read.
